GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (6 Mar 47) GC
(SCAPIN - 1558)
APO 500
6 March 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Japanese Nationals Remaining in North Korea.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Paragraph 5 of Annex I to Memorandum from the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG 370.05 (7 May 46)GC, (SCAPIN-927), dated 7 May 1946, subject: Repatriation, as amended.
b. Memorandum from the Central Liaison Office, Tokyo, C.L.O. Number 1280 (RJ), dated 28 February 1947, subject as above.
2. As mentioned in reference paragraph 1 a above, the prerogative to establish the priority of release of Japanese repatriates now in Soviet and Soviet-controlled territories, rests with the Soviet Area Commanders concerned.
3. The ship Taian Maru is scheduled to arrive at Konan, Korea, on or about 19 March 1947. This ship may be utilized by the Soviet officials to repatriate Japanese nationals now in northern Korea.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
